item.title: German Leon Glatzer Wants You to Look at Surfing Differently
item.description: Leon Glatzer was raised by German parents in Costa Rica and has proven himself on the world stage. Now he wants people to see his surfing in a different light.

item.title: Surfer Rescued From Brink of Death Explains Why It Pays to Be Friendly In the Lineup
item.description: A Southern California surfer showed how being kind to fellow surfers in the lineup can pay dividends after he suffered a spinal cord injury in Oceanside.

item.title: California Elephant Seals Face Threat From Bird Flu Linked to Mass Die-Offs
item.description: A virus that has proven deadly for colonies of southern elephant seals was discovered in a California population. Researchers are closely monitoring the spread.

item.title: Stratton Matteson, Accomplished Splitboarder, Dies in Avalanche Near Whistler, B.C.
item.description: The victim of a fatal avalanche near Whistler, Canada has been identified as 28-year-old Stratton Matteson, a well-known backcountry rider from Bend, Oregon.

item.title: Pleasure Point Reserve Proposal Amended to Allow Recreational Fishing; Critics Remain Unmoved
item.description: Despite concessions in a new proposed preserve at Pleasure Point in Santa Cruz, local opposition isn't satisfied.

item.title: Video: Woman Seen Dangling From Chairlift at Big Bear Resort
item.description: A new video shows a woman was left precariously dangling from a chairlift as her fellow skiers hang on for dear life at Big Bear Mountain Resort.

item.title: While Everyone Else Surfed Step Ups, Mason Ho Rode a 5’6″ at Sunset and Pipeline
item.description: If you paddle out at big Sunset or big Pipeline, chances are, you won't see a board under six feet. Unless, of course, Mason Ho is there.

item.title: Kelly Slater and Gabriel Medina Spent a Day Together at Beyond the Club São Paulo
item.description: In the world of surfing, two are more famous than the rest: Kelly Slater and Gabriel Medina. They paddled out at Brazil's Beyond the Club São Paulo.

item.title: Surf Industry Leader Says ‘It’s Chaos,’ and That Businesses Are Still Reeling Under Tariffs
item.description: Even though the Supreme Court ruled that some of President Trump's tariffs are illegal, a surf industry leader says brands have received little relief.

item.title: Mammoth Mountain Will Stay Open ‘Through At Least Memorial Day’ After February Storms
item.description: The potential Memorial Day closing date would give Mammoth Mountain 188 days of operation this season. Last year the resort stayed open into mid-June.
